title: Redcurrant Hangover Crumble
description: A sweet breakfast treat using redcurrants and a crunchy hangover cure crumble topping. Perfect for a morning pick-me-up.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together redcurrants and hangover cure.
Transfer the mixture to a 6-inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix together crumble and cinnamon.
Spread the crumble mixture evenly over the redcurrant mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown.
Serve warm with fresh redcurrants on top, if desired.
